items.markdown:
The best time to visit Phuket is during the dry season from **November to April** , when you can enjoy sunny skies, calm blue seas, and comfortable temperatures ideal for the beach.[](https://www.tui.co.uk/holidays/weather/asia/thailand/thailand/phuket.html) [[1]](https://www.tui.co.uk/holidays/weather/asia/thailand/thailand/phuket.html)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/sonny.caringal.7/videos/-best-worst-time-to-visit-phuket-most-people-get-this-wrong-%EF%B8%8F-best-time-to-visit/1649747092935516/)

Dry Season (November–April)

- **December to February:** Peak months with the coolest temperatures (24°C to 32°C), lowest humidity, and best conditions for island-hopping. This is the busiest and most expensive time, especially around Christmas and New Year.[](https://www.wyndhamgrandnaiharnphuket.com/discover/best-time-to-visit-phuket) [[1]](https://www.wyndhamgrandnaiharnphuket.com/discover/best-time-to-visit-phuket)[[2]](https://www.makemytrip.com/tripideas/phuket/best-time-to-visit)[[3]](https://www.getyourguide.com/explorer/phuket-ttd32123/best-time-to-visit-phuket/)
- **March to April:** Very hot temperatures often exceeding 34°C. April hosts the famous Songkran water festival (Thai New Year) from April 13–15.[](https://www.wyndhamgrandnaiharnphuket.com/discover/best-time-to-visit-phuket) 

Wet Season (May–October)

- **May to August:** The onset of the southwest monsoon brings frequent tropical showers—usually short 30-minute to 2-hour afternoon bursts rather than all-day rain. Hotel rates drop by 30% to 50%.[](https://www.kuoni.co.uk/destinations/south-east-asia/thailand/phuket/best-time-to-visit/) [[1]](https://www.kuoni.co.uk/destinations/south-east-asia/thailand/phuket/best-time-to-visit/)[[2]](https://www.tuiholidays.ie/f/holidays/weather/asia/thailand/thailand/phuket.html)
- **September to October:** The wettest and quietest months of the year. Sea conditions can be rough with strong currents, making swimming unsafe at some western beaches, but the island is lush and uncrowded.[](https://www.wyndhamgrandnaiharnphuket.com/discover/best-time-to-visit-phuket) [[1]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DUktP35EUzr/)
